rows.scopeSummary:
Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) has been awarded a seven year, $ 644mn (Euro 550 mn) contract by Tryg to simplify and standardise Tryg' operations across its three major markets at Denmark, Sweden and Norway.

TCS will use its suite of AI and Cloud solutions across Tryg’s entire IT landscape to augment delivery capability, automate core processes and elevate customer experience. Taking ownership of application development and management, end-to-end infrastructure services, end-user services, and cybersecurity, TCS will propel Tryg’s ‘United Towards 27’ vision aimed at simplifying its IT operations and builds the capacity to develop new digital solutions for more than six million customers. TCS streamlines a historically complex IT landscape shaped by organic growth and acquisitions, unify fragmented operating models across geographies, and embed automation and AI to enhance efficiency in every element of the IT operations value chain. rows.scopeSummary:
Cognizant Technology Solutions Corp has been awarded a contract by Citizens Financial Group Inc

Citizens Financial Group Inc. has announced a partnership with Cognizant to establish a Global Capability Center (GCC) in Hyderabad, India, aimed at accelerating innovation and enhancing the bank's enterprise technology strategy. This center will be located within Cognizant's new campus and is expected to scale up to 1,000 IT and Data Analytics professionals by March 2026. The GCC will focus on implementing cutting-edge technologies and fostering a culture of continuous learning, supporting Citizens' "Next Generation Technology" (NGT) strategy, which emphasizes cloud migration, advanced technology, data security, and innovation. 

Cognizant plans to leverage its Cognizant Neuro and FlowSource platforms to deliver GenAI-enabled solutions, while also creating a Banking and Financial Services Innovation Center to enhance operational security, compliance, and customer experience. The initiative

valueEstimate.explanation: GlobalData's own text: the value was estimated by GlobalData, not disclosed by the parties

rows.scopeSummary:
Infosys Ltd has been awarded a contract by Spark New Zealand Ltd to provide global DevOps and software engineering services to support the transformation of its technology delivery model. Under the contract, Infosys will help build, test, integrate and deliver Spark’s systems and applications, along with monitoring and support. Spark will use Infosys Topaz and Infosys Cobalt to help reduce IT operating costs while also accelerating company’s strategy of enabling digital and AI-driven customer experiences. Spark will continue to retain its IT assets and control its technology architecture strategy, product design and innovation roadmap, and business applications, supported by Infosys’ global reach and expertise.


GlobalData has estimated the value and duration of the contract.

The platform provides real-time insights into employee engagement and retention, performance management, and workplace planning, ensuring regulatory compliance and enhancing employee experience.
